producer_report.summary: Root cause: the agent driver loop enforced only a fixed wall-clock deadline and tracked no progress, so a stalled producer burned the full 1800s. The loop in claude.rs now records the time of the last line on the agent's stream. If none appears for the stall window, it kills the group and returns TimedOut with the detail 'no progress for Ns (stalled)'. The window is a third of the timeout (600s at 1800s), never less than 60s, so short timeouts still report the deadline reason. The reason string and window logic are in procs.rs next to deadline_reason. There is no new outcome variant, no new invocation field, and the existing kept-work and retry handling is untouched. New tests cover a silent agent stopped early, a slow but steady agent that completes, and the window arithmetic. The CHANGELOG has an entry.

learnings: The existing hang test uses a 2s timeout, so a pure timeout/3 window would have fired as a stall and broken it. A 60s floor on the window keeps that test unchanged.
Tests lower the floor through a private driver field min_stall_window, which avoids a new AgentInvocation field.
